name: 67: The 7 Pages
summary: You're in a spooky forest and 7 pages have been scattered around, but the 67 kid has suddenly become evil and is hunting you down.
A short game where you guess whether it is a 6 or a 7. Can you 6-7 to the top?

name: 6-7 Nights At Vicente's
summary: 6-7 Nights at Vicente’s is a horror and strategy game in the style of Five Nights at Freddy’s. On Morcilla Island, Detective Rubevids investigates Vicente’s house, where he must keep watch, manage resources, and survive threats to uncover the truth before it’s too late.
A quick reaction game inspired by the 67 meme. React at the exact right moment, or it’s over. Simple, fast, and all about pure reflex.

name: 67 Game Online
summary:
The 67 Game Online is an AI-powered browser challenge that test your speed. Using computer vision and your webcam, the game tracks your movements in real-time to count how many "67" gestures you can perform in a 15 seconds sprint.

Climb the Leaderboard: Compare your skill with friends and players worldwide in a real time ranking system.

Instant Play: No download required. Just your browser, your webcam, and your arms.

name: 67 Minutes in Heaven
summary: Your neighbor invites you on a double date, setting you up with the new girl from out of town. After sneaking into an abandoned house, your neighbor suggests everyone play a game, 67 Minutes in Heaven.
